lines.text: Hello, I left something at the station. It is a small case for my glasses.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: We found two glasses cases today. What does yours look like?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: It is brown, and it has a white star on top. It opens like a little box.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: I have that case here. You can collect it from the front desk before five fifteen.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Could you repeat the time more slowly? Did you say five fifty?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Five fifteen, a quarter past five. After that, come to the ticket office instead.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Thanks. I will be there at five thirty, so I should go to the ticket office.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Exactly. Tell them it is the brown case with the white star on top.
lines.speaker: Eli
